_about: The Editor's verifier, one way for the Python Editor and the viewer's: run by tests/test_verify_cases.py (verify.verify, as gui/editorlink.py runs it) and viewer-shell/editcore/tests/cases.rs (editcore::verify). Each case is a load order (`plugins`, each with its masters and its records in the tes3conv schema, written to files for the script compiler: the records with an id, its scripts as the compiler makes them), `files` (what the data folders have), and operations: ["set", tag, id, path, value], ["whole", tag, id, plugin], ["set_ref", cell, origin, index, field, value], ["insert", tag, id], ["save_script", tag, id, text], ["verify", look for files]. `expect` is what each gave and the journal after them. Generated from the Python side when a case is added, and read by hand.
